params.caption: 🎮 Viral warning: can GTA 6 codes be read through sealed boxes? Days before launch, GTA 6 players are sharing concerns about a possible flaw that could let people see download codes through sealed physical copies. If you are buying a boxed copy, check the packaging when you pick it up. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 22:51 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 📦 Physical or digital for GTA 6?
